assamese.title: IIT Guwahati researchers unveil energy-efficient AI model for data processing
assamese.summary: Researchers at IIT Guwahati's data science school developed a brain-inspired AI system for processing long data sequences with reduced energy consumption, presented at an international machine learning conference.

assamese.title: Guwahati cinema documentary selected for Kerala Film Festival
assamese.summary: A documentary about Guwahati's cinema heritage has been chosen for screening at Kerala Film Festival.

assamese.title: Small Tea Growers take centre stage at Tea Board's Innovation Expo in Ahmedabad
assamese.summary: Small-scale tea producers from Assam are showcasing their work at the Tea Board's innovation event in Gujarat.

assamese.title: AI push in Assam govt schools: 1 lakh teachers to get training by May 2027
assamese.summary: The Assam government plans to train one lakh teachers in artificial intelligence by May 2027, providing them with digital identities and AI-powered educational tools.

assamese.title: Rooftop solar lights up Assam homes as households see lower power bills
assamese.summary: Over 1.10 lakh households in Assam have installed rooftop solar systems and are now receiving zero electricity bills.

hindi.title: करण जौहर राधा-कृष्ण की प्रेम कहानी पर बना रहे बड़े बजट की फिल्म
hindi.summary: निर्देशक करण जौहर जन्म से लेकर पौराणिक घटनाओं तक राधा-कृष्ण की दिव्य प्रेम कहानी पर आधारित एक बड़े बजट की फिल्म बना रहे हैं।

hindi.title: स्मृति मंधाना बनीं महिला अंतरराष्ट्रीय क्रिकेट की सबसे बड़ी रन-स्कोरर
hindi.summary: एशिया कप टी20 के एक मैच में 124 रन बनाकर मंधाना ने मिताली राज को पीछे छोड़ा; भारत ने हॉन्गकॉन्ग को 137 रन से हराकर सेमीफाइनल में जगह बनाई।

english.title: ISRO successfully launches EOS-05 Earth observation satellite
english.summary: EOS-05 launched aboard GSLV-F17 from Sriharikota on September 4 — India's first imaging satellite in geosynchronous orbit, for agriculture, disaster management and resource mapping.

english.title: Spain matches September heat record at 45.7°C as extreme heat grips country
english.summary: Spain saw record-matching heat this week amid an extreme heat spell across the country.

english.title: Ultrahuman raises $70M with Qualcomm backing to build smart rings into AI computing platforms
english.summary: The Indian wearable startup is expanding its smart ring line into an AI-enabled computing platform.

english.title: Bond yields are surging globally — but why aren't equities falling?
english.summary: Analysts weigh in on why rising global bond yields haven't dragged down stock markets as expected.
